name: Nakazono Akane
source: An office lady with naive, gentle and friendly personality. She is pretty popular among men and customers at work. She is also daughter of a big shareholder of the company and Hayato's fiancé. She gets along with both the protagonist and her boyfriend. However, she never imagined that she would get caught in the dirty feud between the two evil men.
